Title: Document 3
Content: Source: Captain Francis Pott, Court Records of Northampton County, Virginia, `text(1645)-text(1651)`.

I, Capt. Francis Pott, have taken to service `text(two)` daughters of my Negro, Emanuell Dregis. The one whose name is Elizabeth is to serve `text(thirteen years)` which will be complete and ended in the `text(first)` part of `text(March, 1658)`. And the other child whose name is Jane Dregis (being about `text(one year)` old) is to serve the said Capt. Pott until she arrive to the age of `text(thirty years)` old.

And I, the said Francis Pott, do promise to give them sufficient meat, drink, apparel and lodging and to use my best endeavor to bring them up in the fear of God and in the knowledge of our Savior Christ Jesus.
